questions.knowledge_point: Finding the Coefficient Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
questions.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}-2y=1 \\ 3x=-1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
questions.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered  $x,y$ 
 on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient: 

$$
{\begin{aligned}0x-2y=1 \\ 3x+0y=-1\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}0 & -2 \\ 3 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

questions.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x+2y=3 \\ -4y+5z=6 \\ 7x+8z=9\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
questions.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y,z$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x+2y+0z=3 \\ 0x-4y+5z=6 \\ 7x+0y+8z=9\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & \,\,\,-4 & 5 \\ 7 & 0 & 8\end{aligned}]
$$

questions.knowledge_point: Finding the System of Equations Associated With an Augmented Matrix
questions.problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

$$
[\begin{aligned}7 & -4 & 0 & 9 \\ -3 & 1 & 5 & 0 \\ 3 & -4 & 8 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$
questions.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$, $y$, and $z,$ then, the corresponding system of equations is

$$
{\begin{aligned}7x-4y+0z=9 \\ -3x+y+5z=0 \\ 3x-4y+8z=3.\end{aligned}
$$

By simplifying, we obtain

$$
{\begin{aligned}7x-4y=9 \\ -3x+y+5z=0 \\ 3x-4y+8z=3.\end{aligned}
$$

questions.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{3}m+5n=11 \\ 0=4n-8 \\ n=-6m+\frac{2}{5}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
questions.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $m,n$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{3}m+5n=11 \\ 0m-4n=-8 \\ 6m+n=\frac{2}{5}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{3} & 5 \\ 0 & -4 \\ 6 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{3} & 5 & 11 \\ 0 & -4 & -8 \\ 6 & 1 & \frac{2}{5}\end{aligned}]
$$

What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
{\begin{aligned}y+x-5-3z=0 \\ z=y+7x \\ y+3-2z=1-2x\end{aligned}
$$
canonical_examples.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y,z$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}x+y-3z=5 \\ -7x-y+z=0 \\ 2x+y-2z=-2\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
\left\lbrack
	\matrix {
		1 & 1 & -3 \
		-7 & -1 & 1 \
                2 & 1 & -2 
	}
	\right\rbrack
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & -3 & 5 \\ -7 & -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 2 & 1 & -2 & -2\end{aligned}
$$

canonical_examples.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
{\begin{aligned}\frac{c}{2}=a \\ 5+3b-a=4c \\ d=1\end{aligned}
$$
canonical_examples.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $a,b,c,d$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}-a+0b+\frac{1}{2}c+0d=0 \\ -a+3b-4c+0d=-5 \\ 0a+0b+0c+d=1\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & \frac{1}{2} & 0 \\ -1 & 3 & -4 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & \frac{1}{2} & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 3 & -4 & 0 & -5 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}
$$
